seed_conventions.served_rows: existence=served rows are runtime-generated artefacts (not tree files); the validator skips tree-existence for them by design.
seed_conventions.families: family rows count as ONE registry row (D-5); members are enumerated at seed and checked against the tree by member_glob.
seed_conventions.budget_bytes: for single rows, the sweep budget (= size_cap_bytes); for family rows, the family total budget.
